	public static void main(String[] args) {
		var s = new Scanner(System.in);

			int n = s.nextInt();

			int[] b = new int[3];
			for(int i=0;i<3;i++){
				a[i] = s.nextInt();
			}

				b[i] = s.nextInt();
			}
			int sum = 0;

			for(int i=0;i<3;i++){
				sum += Math.min(a[i],b[(i+1)%3]);
			}
			System.out.println(sum);
		}
	}
}
